{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check the count
print("Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH:")
print(len(filtered))

# Check how many of them converted
converted_count = filtered['converted'].sum()
print("Number who converted:")
print(converted_count)

# Compute the fraction
fraction = converted_count / len(filtered)
print("Fraction converted:")
print(fraction)"}
